headline: Oil Prices Rise on US Inventory Draw as Petrobras Shares Slip
summary: Crude oil rose around 2% after U.S. crude stocks dropped by 1.89 million barrels, lifting the USO fund while Petrobras slipped 1.21%.
why: U.S. inventory reports provide critical signals on global energy supply-demand balance, directly influencing oil producers worldwide.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: A drawdown in crude inventory indicates tighter physical supplies relative to market expectations.

why_moved: An unexpected crude drawdown tightened physical availability expectations, driving oil futures higher.
